accordion.name: Accordion
accordion.description: A vertically stacked list of headers that reveal associated content areas when clicked.
propsDefinitions: export type AccordionTriggerProps = React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'button'>;
export type AccordionContentProps = React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;

animatenumber.name: AnimateNumber
animatenumber.description: A specialized component for creating sleek numeric counters with independent digit animations. It uses a "top-to-bottom" sliding effect for each character, providing a premium and dynamic feel for dashboards and metrics.

areachart.name: AreaChart
areachart.description: The **AreaChart** component is a lightweight, responsive data visualization tool built using native SVG and **Framer Motion**. It's designed to be lean, performant, and deeply customizable through theme tokens.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: A versatile component for presenting user profile pictures, with built-in fallback Support and smooth loading transitions.

backdrop.name: Backdrop
backdrop.description: A blurred or semi-transparent full-screen overlay, often used behind modals, drawers, or to dim the background for focus.

badge.name: Badge
badge.description: Visual indicators used for counts, statuses, or high-priority labels. Dashkit provides two distinct badge components optimized for different use cases.

barchart.name: BarChart
barchart.description: The **BarChart** component is a powerful, animated data visualization tool built for comparing discrete categories or showing distribution across groups. It supports multiple grouped series, interactive tooltips, and smooth entrance animations.

bento-grid.name: BentoGrid
bento-grid.description: A modular grid layout system for building regular and irregular Bento or Hairline grids while maintaining seamless `1px` shared border coherence across arbitrary column/row spans and responsive breakpoints.

breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: A secondary navigation component that helps users understand their current location in the application hierarchy.

button.name: Button
button.description: A highly customizable button component supporting multiple variants, icons, and loading states.

buttongroup.name: ButtonGroup
buttongroup.description: The **ButtonGroup** component is used to cluster multiple buttons together in a single, cohesive unit. This is often used for toolbar actions, toggle switches, or navigation. It features a modern, border-aware outlined design with dedicated selection states.

card.name: Card
card.description: Dashkit's Card is designed as a **composed wrapper**, providing total layout control through granular sub-components.
propsDefinitions: export type CardDescriptionProps = React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'p'>;
export type CardContentProps = React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>;
export type CardFooterProps = React.ComponentPropsWithRef<'div'>;

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.description: A custom-styled checkbox component for binary choices, with support for labels and descriptions.

chip.name: Chip
chip.description: A compact, interactive element that represents an input, attribute, or action, inspired by Material Design 3.

circularprogress.name: CircularProgress
circularprogress.description: A high-fidelity circular progress indicator built with SVG and Framer Motion. It provides smooth, fluid animations for status monitoring, health metrics, and loading states.

colorpicker.name: ColorPicker
colorpicker.description: A premium color picker component that allows users to select from a curated list of presets or provide a custom hex value.

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.description: A combobox is a flexible select component that allows users to filter a large list of options via a search input.

commandpalette.name: CommandPalette
commandpalette.description: A fast, keyboard-first command menu (`Cmd+K` / `Ctrl+K`) for triggering actions, searching records, and navigating workspaces.

copyfield.name: CopyField
copyfield.description: A specialized input component designed for displaying read-only text that needs to be copied to the clipboard, such as invite links, API keys, or referral codes.

datefield.name: DateField
datefield.description: A premium, HeroUI-inspired input component for entering and editing date values with individual segments for Day, Month, and Year.

datepicker.name: DatePicker
datepicker.description: A minimal, animated date selection component built with native React and Framer Motion. Ideal for dashboards and forms that require single date selection with a premium look.

divider.name: Divider
divider.description: A versatile component used to separate sections of content with horizontal or vertical lines.

dock.name: Dock
dock.description: A fluid, magnified navigation bar inspired by macOS, using Framer Motion for high-fidelity interactive physics.

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.description: A premium panel component that slides in from the edges of the screen, providing a temporary surface for navigation, settings, or details. It uses a compositional pattern to give you full control over the header, content, and footer sections.
propsDefinitions: export type DrawerHeaderProps = ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;
export type DrawerContentProps = ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;
export type DrawerFooterProps = ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;

dropdown.name: Dropdown
dropdown.description: An interactive menu that displays a list of actions or options when triggered.
propsDefinitions:
export interface DropdownProps extends React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'> {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Compound menu popover (`children` with `DropdownTrigger`, `DropdownContent`, `DropdownItem`).
 *
 * @example
 * ```tsx
 * <Dropdown>
 *   <DropdownTrigger>Actions</DropdownTrigger>
 *   <DropdownContent>
 *     <DropdownItem onClick={onEdit}>Edit</DropdownItem>
 *   </DropdownContent>
 * </Dropdown>
 * ```
 */
export type DropdownLabelProps = React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;
export type DropdownSeparatorProps = ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;

fileupload.name: FileUpload
fileupload.description: A drag-and-drop file upload dropzone with file size validation, per-file progress bars, and status indicators.

float-action-menu.name: FloatActionMenu
float-action-menu.description: A premium floating action button that reveals an interactive menu card sliding from right to left.

floatbadge.name: FloatBadge
floatbadge.description: Visual indicators used for counts, statuses, or high-priority labels. Dashkit provides two distinct badge components optimized for different use cases.

iconbutton.name: IconButton
iconbutton.description: A premium, specialized button for icon-only actions with customizable variant and rounding options.
propsDefinitions:
export type IconButtonProps = IconButtonBaseProps &
  (
    | (React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { href?: never })
    | (React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> & { href: string })
  );

/**
 * Prop-driven (`icon`) square or pill action button; renders `<a>` automatically when `href` is passed.
 *
 * @example
 * ```tsx
 * <IconButton icon={<PlusIcon />} aria-label="Add item" variant="soft" />
 * ```
 */

imageexpander.name: ImageExpander
imageexpander.description: A premium component that enables cinematic image expansion with smooth animations, backdrop blur, and caption support.

input.name: Input
input.description: A primitive input component with support for labels, icons, error states, and helper text.

linechart.name: LineChart
linechart.description: The **LineChart** component is a clean, minimal data visualization tool built using native SVG and **Framer Motion**. It's ideal for showing precise trends without the visual weight of an area fill.

listtile.name: ListTile
listtile.description: A flexible row component for building lists, menus, and settings panels. Supports leading icons or avatars, a title and subtitle text block, and a trailing slot for actions or indicators.

modal.name: Modal
modal.description: A centered, layered dialog component that focuses user attention on critical information or actions.
propsDefinitions: export type ModalContentProps = ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;
export type ModalFooterProps = ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'>;

navbar.name: Navbar
navbar.description: A premium, responsive navigation header with support for branding, navigation, and action buttons using a flexible composition pattern.
propsDefinitions: export interface NavbarProps extends React.HTMLAttributes, StrictVariantProps { children: React.ReactNode; } /** * Compound sticky top navigation bar (`children`). * * @example * ```tsx * * Dashkit * * ``` */

navigation-menu.name: NavigationMenu
navigation-menu.description: A premium navigation menu component inspired by modern, high-end dashboards. It features a shared viewport that smoothly moves and resizes to accommodate different content sections.
propsDefinitions:
export interface NavigationMenuProps extends React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'nav'> {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Compound desktop navigation bar (`children` with `NavigationMenuList`, `NavigationMenuItem`, `NavigationMenuTrigger`, `NavigationMenuContent`).
 *
 * @example
 * ```tsx
 * <NavigationMenu>
 *   <NavigationMenuList>
 *     <NavigationMenuItem value="docs">
 *       <NavigationMenuTrigger>Docs</NavigationMenuTrigger>
 *       <NavigationMenuContent>Links</NavigationMenuContent>
 *     </NavigationMenuItem>
 *   </NavigationMenuList>
 * </NavigationMenu>
 * ```
 */
export type NavigationMenuViewportProps = Omit<HTMLMotionProps<'div'>, 'children'>;

otpinput.name: OtpInput
otpinput.description: A premium input component optimized for One-Time Passwords, featuring automatic focus shifting, digit masking, and full paste support.

pagination.name: Pagination
pagination.description: A functional and responsive component for navigating between large sets of data or views.

piechart.name: PieChart
piechart.description: The **PieChart** component is an expressive tool for visualizing categorical distributions. It features interactive segments with tooltips, smooth hover scaling, and supports donut variations via the `innerRadius` prop.

popover.name: Popover
popover.description: A floating container that displays rich content anchored to a trigger element. Popovers are ideal for more complex content than tooltips, such as forms or descriptive text.

progressbar.name: ProgressBar
progressbar.description: Animated, fluid indicators for tracking task completion, loading states, or data metrics with high precision.

radio.name: Radio
radio.description: A premium radio button component for single choices from a set, with support for labels and descriptions.

scrollarea.name: ScrollArea
scrollarea.description: A minimalist scroll area component that provides theme-aware, custom scrollbars across all browsers and operating systems.

select.name: Select
select.description: A high-performance dropdown component for single choices, featuring portalled rendering to prevent layout overflow and full keyboard accessibility.

sidebar.name: Sidebar
sidebar.description: A versatile and premium navigation sidebar component that supports complex layouts, branding, status indicators, and responsive mobile drawer adaptation out of the box.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.description: A placeholder component used to mimic the layout of actual content while it is loading.
propsDefinitions:
export interface SkeletonProps
  extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>,
    StrictVariantProps<typeof skeletonVariants> {}

/**
 * Animated loading placeholder (`variant="text" | "circular" | "rectangular"`).
 *
 * @example
 * ```tsx
 * <Skeleton variant="rectangular" className="h-24 w-full" />
 * ```
 */

slider.name: Slider
slider.description: A premium, interactive slider component for selecting a value from a range, featuring smooth animations and real-time feedback.

spinner.name: Spinner
spinner.description: A sleek, high-performance loading indicator built with SVG and CSS animations.

statscard.name: StatsCard
statscard.description: A high-level component for displaying key performance indicators, metrics, and trends at a glance.

stepper.name: Stepper
stepper.description: A progress visualization component for multi-step processes or sequence indicators.

surface.name: Surface
surface.description: A lightweight, foundational component for creating containers with consistent background variants based on design system states. It provides a clean, borderless surface with no internal padding or margin, serving as a pure visual block.

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: A high-performance, premium toggle switch component for binary choices, with support for labels and descriptions.

systemlogs.name: SystemLogs
systemlogs.description: A terminal-style component for displaying real-time system logs, process outputs, or audit trails with auto-scrolling and status indicators.

table.name: Table
table.description: A simple, responsive table component for displaying structured data.
propsDefinitions:
export type TableProps = HTMLAttributes; /** * Compound semantic data table (`children` with `TableContainer`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell`). * * @example * ```tsx * * * * Name * * * Alice * *
* * ``` */

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: A performant and premium tabs component with a smooth, fluid indicator animation powered by Framer Motion.

taginput.name: TagInput
taginput.description: A multi-select tag input supporting keyboard navigation (`ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Backspace`, `Delete`), delimiter commits, and autocomplete suggestions.

textarea.name: Textarea
textarea.description: A multiline text input component with support for labels, error states, and auto-growing height.

toast.name: Toast
toast.description: A succinct message that provides feedback about an operation in a small, non-intrusive card.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.description: A small popup that displays information when a user hovers over an element.
